mapper.select:
SELECT D.SUBNAME AS ITEMTYPE, B.SUBNAME AS CAR, ITEMCODE, SPEC, ITEMNAME, C.SUBNAME AS UNIT, DELDATE FROM T_MI_ITEM A INNER JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB B ON A.CARNO = B.SUBCODE AND B.TYPECODE = 'MI041' LEFT JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB C ON A.CMB_UNIT = C.SUBCODE AND C.TYPECODE = 'MI001' LEFT JOIN T_MI_TYPESUB D ON A.CMB_ITEMTYPE = D.SUBCODE AND D.TYPECODE = 'MI002' WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BRANCH = '001' -- 울산 고정 (추후 수정 예정)
AND DELDATE = ' '
AND UPPER(D.SUBNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemtype}) || '%'
AND UPPER(B.SUBNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{car}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ITEMCODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemcode}) || '%'
AND UPPER(SPEC) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{spec}) || '%'
AND UPPER(ITEMNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{itemname}) || '%'
ORDER BY ITEMCODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SCM_BARCODE ( BARCODE, KIND, INDATE, MADATE, LOTNO, PNO, PNAME, QTY, TOTALQTY, USEYN, LABELTYPE, CNAME, CNO, LOGINID ) VALUES ( #{barcode}, 'WMS', #{sdate}, #{sdate}, #{lotno}, #{itemcode}, #{itemname}, #{qty}, #{totalqty}, 'Y', 'EXCEPTIONIN', #{custname}, (SELECT DISTINCT CU_CODE FROM C_CUST WHERE CU_SANGHO = #{custname}), #{loginid} )
mapper.update: -- T_SCM_BARCODE_MAX 테이블에 ITEMCODE, SDATE가 매칭되는게 있으면 BARCODE(LOTNO)만 업데이트 -- 매칭되는게 없다면 INSERT MERGE INTO T_SCM_BARCODE_MAX A USING ( SELECT #{itemcode} AS ITEMCODE, #{sdate} AS SDATE, #{lotno} AS LOTNO FROM DUAL )B ON ( A.PNO = B.ITEMCODE AND A.MADATE = B.SDATE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.BARCODE = B.LOTNO WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PNO, MADATE, BARCODE ) VALUES ( B.ITEMCODE, B.SDATE, B.LOTNO )
mapper.select: SELECT PBARCODE FROM T_SCM_PALLET WHERE SDATE = #{date} ORDER BY PBARCODE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SCM_PALLET ( PBARCODE, SDATE, BBARCODE, YMDHMS, LOGINID, ITEMCODE, CUSTCODE, CUSTNAME, BDATE, SEQ, QTY, SCMMEX, LABELTYPE, LASTSTATUS, LASTFACTORY, FACTORY, LASTQTY ) VALUES ( #{pbarcode}, #{sdate}, #{barcode}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{loginid}, #{itemcode}, #{custcode}, #{custname}, #{bdate}, #{seq}, #{qty}, #{scmmex}, #{labelType}, #{laststatus}, #{factory}, #{factory}, #{qty} )
